name: book_appointment
description: Book a drop-off appointment at the shop. Call ONLY after you have collected and read back name, phone, vehicle, service, date and time. If it returns booked=false, offer the alternatives it gives.

phone.description: Callback phone number, digits only with area code. Default to the caller ID if they confirm it.

vehicle.description: Year, make and model, e.g. 2017 Chevy Malibu

service.description: What they need: oil change, brakes, A/C, check engine light, collision/body estimate, tires, etc.

preferred_date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Resolve words like 'tomorrow' using the current date in the system prompt.

preferred_time.description: Time in 24h HH:MM shop local time, e.g. 09:00 or 14:30

language.description: Language of the call: en, es, fr or ht

notes.description: Anything else useful: symptoms, insurance claim, needs a ride, etc.
